scope: M03-P01-IP-005 Cloud region/AZ cell taxonomy per-cell isolation evidence API slice
implementation_summary: Extended Cloud AZ list records with deterministic per-cell isolation evidence projected from the existing CloudRegionCatalog.
Added public CloudCellIsolationEvidenceRecord fields for cell id, region, AZ, state, tenant density, allowed residency, evidence ref, and schema version.
Kept sensitive/live runtime details out of API output: capacity, utilization, raw HSM partition refs, provider SDKs, credentials, and network calls are not exposed or invoked.
Updated the Cloud region OpenAPI contract so CloudAzRecord requires cell_isolation_evidence and declares the evidence schema/data classes.
Updated M03-P01/IP-005 plan status to API-green while leaving live topology smoke explicitly pending.
